notes:
Old work folders of the orders are removed [skip ci]

The review's stress run left 320 folders after 320 orders: an order's work folder (<data>/level7/<order>: the order
sent to the drawing program, its report, its pieces before they are copied to the models' folder) was never removed —
one more for every order, for ever. Once a day now, in the background: a folder goes 3 days after its order was nested
(or written again under a newer number), and after 30 days whatever became of its order; never a fresh one, never one
whose order still waits. What «قياسات التصميم» needs of the report is kept with the order first.
tests/test_level7_safeguards.py (+1). The build is started after the full suite.

Also in this build: 2.0.21 — «تفاصيل الطلب» shows every measurement of the design for the order and where it came
from (the order, or the design's own value).
